name: react
title: React
conventions: Use function components and hooks, and keep each component focused on one responsibility.
Prefer derived state over synchronized state and avoid duplicating server data in local state.
Type props and API payloads and avoid any.
Use semantic HTML and accessible labels for every interactive element.
Colocate tests with the component or feature they cover.
Keep data fetching in a dedicated layer and handle loading, empty, and error states.
